info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Rideshare Rides Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Cancel Rideshare Rides API allows users to efficiently cancel previously scheduled rideshare rides. By leveraging this API, stakeholders such as rideshare drivers and passengers can manage their ride bookings in real-time, ensuring flexibility and customer satisfaction. This operation helps maintain accurate ride statuses and provides a seamless experience for users needing to adjust plans. The API supports common use cases, including cancellations due to changes in travel plans or emergencies. Integration with this API enables quick and straightforward cancellations while enhancing overall service reliability.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel a previously booked ride. Ensure that the ride is eligible for cancellation as per the policy before proceeding.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a ride. It should include all necessary information required by the server to process the cancellation request.

201.description: The ride cancellation request was processed successfully, and the ride has been canceled.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling a ride operation via DELETE method. It specifies the input format expected by the server.
